title: Suspended DICT exec denies wrongdoing in P1.5-B contracts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Embattled Information and Communications Technology Undersecretary David Almirol Jr. has denied allegations of conflict of interest involving government contracts worth more than P1.5 billion, which were awarded to a company he founded. Almirol broke his silence a day after the Office of the Ombudsman ordered his preventive suspension for six months without pay over alleged irregularities involving contracts awarded to companies linked to Multisys, which he established in 2010. READ: Ombudsman suspends DICT exec over alleged conflict in P1.5-B deal “I firmly maintain that there was no conflict of interest,” Almirol said in a statement posted on social media […]...
